basic_details.short_information: Kalyan Singh Super Specialty Cancer Institute (KSSSCI), Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, has invited applications for the post of Senior Resident (Hospital Services) under Advt No. KSSSCI/ ER / 120-D /1447/2026. Selection is through a walk-in interview on 19 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: RTGS/NEFT to Account No. 37868945001, 'Director, SSCI&H, Academic Account', State Bank of India, SGPGIMS, Raebareli Road, Lucknow, IFSC SBIN0007789.

age_limit.age_details: Maximum 45 years (as on date of interview)

qualification.education_qualification: MD/DNB (Obstetrics & Gynaecology); registration with Medical Council / Dental Council of U.P.
qualification.details: Qualification: MD/DNB (Obstetrics & Gynaecology); Registered with Medical Council / Dental Council of U.P. Age limit: Maximum 45 years (as on date of interview) Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/Govt. servants/other categories As per UP Government rules/DoPT rules (only for candidates domiciled in Uttar Pradesh) | Other conditions: | Must be registered with Medical Council / Dental Council of U.P. Reservation and age relaxation only for candidates with Uttar Pradesh domicile Whole-time appointment; private practice of every kind prohibited Must work in shifts and can be posted anywhere in the institute Must stay in campus accommodation if provided Medical fitness certificate from institute-designated Medical board mandatory before joining

salary_details.pay_scale: Initial pay Rs. 67,700 in pay matrix Rs. 67,700-2,08,700, Level-11 (7th Pay Commission)

how_to_apply: Fill the attached application form legibly.
Pay Rs. 500 fee by RTGS/NEFT to Account No. 37868945001, SBI SGPGIMS branch, IFSC SBIN0007789.
Write the fee amount and date on the form and enclose the payment receipt.
Attach self-attested photocopies of all relevant certificates and testimonials.
Report at Admin. Block, KSSSCI, Lucknow at 09:30 AM on the interview day with the form and originals.
Attend on 19 November 2026, reporting at 9:30 AM.
important_instructions: No candidate allowed to appear after 11:00 AM on interview day Positions are indicative and can increase or decrease at the time of interview If no suitable EWS candidate, UR candidate will be considered Results on institute website; appointment letter sent by e-mail No travelling or other allowances paid for joining

content_sections.heading: KSSSCI Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. KSSSCI/ ER / 120-D /1447/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download KSSSCI notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: MD/DNB (Obstetrics & Gynaecology); Registered with Medical Council / Dental Council of U.P. Age limit: Maximum 45 years (as on date of interview) Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/Govt. servants/other categories As per UP Government rules/DoPT rules (only for candidates domiciled in Uttar Pradesh) Other conditions: Must be registered with Medical Council / Dental Council of U.P. Reservation and age relaxation only for candidates with Uttar Pradesh domicile Whole-time appointment; private practice of every kind prohibited Must work in shifts and can be posted anywhere in the institute Must stay in campus accommodation if provided Medical fitness certificate from institute-designated Medical board mandatory before joining

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for KSSSCI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates reporting after 11:00 AM on the interview day Candidates convicted by any court of law Candidates who do not produce original documents at interview

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Tenure of 12 months; contract expires automatically on completion May be renewed or terminated as decided by the Institute; renewal at absolute discretion of Director, KSSSCI Institute can terminate at any time without notice; employee can leave with 30 days' notice or salary in lieu Services may be terminated without notice if bonded candidates from DGME join No right to claim regular appointment or permanent absorption

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: RTGS/NEFT to Account No. 37868945001, 'Director, SSCI&H, Academic Account', State Bank of India, SGPGIMS, Raebareli Road, Lucknow, IFSC SBIN0007789.

content_sections.heading: How Will KSSSCI Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in interview Verification of original documents Walk-in interview begins at 11:00 AM Decision of the committee is final and binding

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Filled application form with fee receipt Self-attested photocopies of all relevant certificates and testimonials Original certificates and testimonials for verification Three recent passport size photographs No Objection Certificate if employed elsewhere

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KSSSCI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the attached application form legibly. Pay Rs. 500 fee by RTGS/NEFT to Account No. 37868945001, SBI SGPGIMS branch, IFSC SBIN0007789. Write the fee amount and date on the form and enclose the payment receipt. Attach self-attested photocopies of all relevant certificates and testimonials. Report at Admin. Block, KSSSCI, Lucknow at 09:30 AM on the interview day with the form and originals. Attend on 19 November 2026, reporting at 9:30 AM.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No candidate allowed to appear after 11:00 AM on interview day Positions are indicative and can increase or decrease at the time of interview If no suitable EWS candidate, UR candidate will be considered Results on institute website; appointment letter sent by e-mail No travelling or other allowances paid for joining
